% Figure for Quantum Mechanics §C11.4★ (Theorem §C11.4.3: CHSH). S = E(a,b) - E(a,b') + E(a',b) + E(a',b') with coplanar axes a, b, a', b' successively theta apart: singlet S = -3 cos(theta) + cos(3 theta) (E = -cos), local band |S| <= 2, violated where |cos theta| > (sqrt3 - 1)/2 (theta < 68.5 deg or > 111.5 deg), extremes -+2 sqrt2 at theta = pi/4, 3pi/4 (Tsirelson). Red: local baseball model (Griffiths Problem 12.3), E_cl(phi) = -1 + 2 phi/pi with phi the angle in [0, pi]; S_cl = -2 for theta <= pi/3, -6 + 12 theta/pi in between, +2 for theta >= 2pi/3. Computed.
